title: One command moves an install to another host
description: Against a temporary install (its database in the install directory, one registry account, a master with an operator-agent and a worker credential), graphyard install move refuses while an item is leased; --plan lists the database, install files and every credential file and changes nothing; applied to a directory standing in for the target host it stops the install and copies the database, files and credentials (0600), sets hostId to the target in connection.json and master.json, and the target's control plane holds the database contents with every registry account on the target host and none refused for it.

steps.name: Move a temporary install to a stand-in target host
